name: bridgeKit
description: Migration tools from Ace3 to the MoltenCodes Kits for World of Warcraft addons: AceSerializer-3.0 text written and read byte for byte, AceConfig-3.0 tables converted to OptionsKit trees, AceDB-3.0 saved variables imported into SettingsKit, and AceComm-3.0 spoken through CommKit, with limits and refusals where Ace3 would raise.
